claims.claim: EMIRA IV is alongside in Gosport, UK (Portsmouth Harbour) as of 5 October 2026.
claims.episode_span: As of 5 October 2026 the team's YB tracker shows EMIRA IV alongside in Gosport, UK (Portsmouth Harbour).
claims.supporting_quote: As of 5 October 2026, the team's YB tracker has EMIRA IV alongside in Gosport, UK (Portsmouth Harbour).

claims.claim: The tracker records one outing since arrival: a training run on 17 September that reached 76 km south of the Isle of Wight.
claims.episode_span: The tracker records one outing in the thirty-day window since arrival: a training run on 17 September that reached 76 km south of the Isle of Wight before returning to the berth shortly after midnight.
claims.supporting_quote: Outings since 5 September 2026 (the tracker's 30-day window): 1 (17 September 2026, out to 76 km from the berth).

claims.claim: Charal 2 has been cut in half at the waterline so the scow-shaped hull bottom can be replaced.
claims.episode_span: Charal 2 has been cut in half at the waterline so the scow-shaped hull bottom can be replaced with a new shape designed to let the boat fly flatter and longer on its foils.
claims.source_title: Charal: A massive, unprecedented refit to keep performing!
claims.supporting_quote: In recent weeks, the IMOCA Charal 2 has been cut in half to remove the hull bottom, which will soon be replaced.

claims.claim: A permanent 1,674-square-metre race-control building is under construction at Port Olona at a cost of 8.8 million euros, due for delivery in June 2028.
claims.episode_span: A permanent 1,674-square-metre race-control building is under construction at Port Olona in Les Sables-d'Olonne at a cost of 8.8 million euros. The facility, due for delivery in June 2028, will replace temporary structures used only during the Vendée Globe.
claims.source_title: Vendée Globe 2028 : 8,8 millions d'euros pour un PC course permanent aux Sables-d'Olonne
claims.supporting_quote: Un nouveau PC course permanent doit être construit à Port Olona, aux Sables-d’Olonne, avec une livraison annoncée pour juin 2028... Le projet représente un investissement de 8,8 millions d’euros. Le futur bâtiment développera 1 674 m²

claims.claim: Baptiste Hulin will line up on 1 November for his first Route du Rhum in the Ocean Fifty class aboard Viabilis Océans.
claims.episode_span: Baptiste Hulin, 29, will line up on 1 November for his first Route du Rhum in the Ocean Fifty class aboard Viabilis Océans.
claims.source_title: Baptiste Hulin: “I want to go out and win more major races”
claims.supporting_quote: Four years after his first Route du Rhum-Destination Guadeloupe in Class40 (18th), Baptiste Hulin (29) is one of the 11 sailors who will line up for the start of the solo transatlantic race aboard an Ocean Fifty on 1 November.
